question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        lt.state,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)) as start_year
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
target_years AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year,
        start_year + 0 as target_year_0,
        start_year + 2 as target_year_2,
        start_year + 4 as target_year_4,
        start_year + 6 as target_year_6,
        start_year + 8 as target_year_8,
        start_year + 10 as target_year_10
    FROM first_terms
),
legislator_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        ty.id_bioguide,
        ty.gender,
        ty.state,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lt.term_start::DATE <= DATE(ty.target_year_0 || '-12-31') AND lt.term_end::DATE > DATE(ty.target_year_0 || '-12-31') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_0,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lt.term_start::DATE <= DATE(ty.target_year_2 || '-12-31') AND lt.term_end::DATE > DATE(ty.target_year_2 || '-12-31') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lt.term_start::DATE <= DATE(ty.target_year_4 || '-12-31') AND lt.term_end::DATE > DATE(ty.target_year_4 || '-12-31') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_4,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lt.term_start::DATE <= DATE(ty.target_year_6 || '-12-31') AND lt.term_end::DATE > DATE(ty.target_year_6 || '-12-31') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_6,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lt.term_start::DATE <= DATE(ty.target_year_8 || '-12-31') AND lt.term_end::DATE > DATE(ty.target_year_8 || '-12-31') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_8,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lt.term_start::DATE <= DATE(ty.target_year_10 || '-12-31') AND lt.term_end::DATE > DATE(ty.target_year_10 || '-12-31') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_10
    FROM target_years ty
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON ty.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY ty.id_bioguide, ty.gender, ty.state,
        ty.target_year_0, ty.target_year_2, ty.target_year_4, ty.target_year_6, ty.target_year_8, ty.target_year_10
),
state_gender_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        AVG(retained_0) * 100 as retention_rate_0,
        AVG(retained_2) * 100 as retention_rate_2,
        AVG(retained_4) * 100 as retention_rate_4,
        AVG(retained_6) * 100 as retention_rate_6,
        AVG(retained_8) * 100 as retention_rate_8,
        AVG(retained_10) * 100 as retention_rate_10
    FROM legislator_retention
    GROUP BY state, gender
),
all_positive AS (
    SELECT state, gender
    FROM state_gender_retention
    WHERE retention_rate_0 > 0 AND retention_rate_2 > 0 AND retention_rate_4 > 0 AND retention_rate_6 > 0 AND retention_rate_8 > 0 AND retention_rate_10 > 0
),
states_with_both AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT state
    FROM all_positive
    WHERE gender = 'M'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT DISTINCT state
    FROM all_positive
    WHERE gender = 'F'
)
SELECT state
FROM states_with_both
ORDER BY state
